reuse.why: Fintegra reuses linkBankSyncAccount and unlinking shares clearBankLink, although its transaction downloader copies the existing Akahu implementation.

duplication.why: The diff duplicates the Akahu download workflow and repeats the conditional clearBankLink call in both account creation and upgrade branches.

placement.why: Link policies, provider downloads, configuration and model types remain in the modules that already own those responsibilities.

scope.why: The edits support the requested linking rules and Fintegra integration, including necessary provider type coverage and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Centralized linking rules and shared unlink cleanup are sound, but another copied downloader and repeated takeover orchestration create avoidable maintenance work.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All provider link handlers use linkBankSyncAccount, and both unlinking paths use clearBankLink; the tree has no shared provider-download abstraction to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The downloader copy and repeated clearBankLink conditional are direct duplication rather than logic concealed through restructuring.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink and five conditional branches for duplicate refusal, upgrade validation, closed-account refusal and clearing the previous holder in each destination branch; all provider handlers still use it.
